:::{#def-exch}
### Exchangeability (marginal exchangeability)

Subpopulations defined by exposure $X$ are **exchangeable**
(also called **marginally exchangeable**,
to set it apart from conditional exchangeability;
@hernan2020causal [sec. 2.2] write "unconditional (or marginal) exchangeability")
with respect to a potential outcome $\potout{x}$
if the distribution of $\potout{x}$
does not depend on the observed exposure $X$:

$$\potout{x} \ind X$$

:::
